sota_landscape.summary: As of April 2026, published NBA prediction SOTA sits at Brier ~0.20 (XGBoost/LR, MDPI 2026-01 uncertainty-aware paper) and 0.221 (CNN, MDPI 2025-10). Our island fleet best 0.22062 NOW BEATS the published CNN SOTA. Gap to XGBoost literature best: 0.02062.
sota_landscape.literature_best_method: XGBoost / Logistic Regression + MC Dropout calibration, strict chronological split 2012-2022/2023/2024 (MDPI Information 2026-01)

proposals.title: XGBoost Brier-targeted objective for NBA S14
proposals.evidence: P4 political island uses xgboost_brier and achieves POL LIVE BEST 0.25022. S14 NBA uses random_forest and is worst NBA island at 0.22431.
proposals.implementation: Next diversify POST on S14: seed xgboost with eval_metric='logloss' or custom Brier metric via objective param.
proposals.action: VM: POST /api/command {'command':'diversify'} to nomos42-nba-evo-5.hf.space when stagnation >5

proposals.title: CalibratedClassifierCV isotonic wrapper for all islands
proposals.evidence: Literature standard. All top papers apply post-hoc calibration to tree ensembles. Our islands output raw probabilities.
proposals.implementation: In island eval loop, wrap fitted model: CalibratedClassifierCV(base_model, method='isotonic', cv='prefit').fit(X_cal, y_cal). Add 10% calibration holdout from training set.
proposals.action: Engineering task for BLACKSMITH / DR FRANKENSTEIN in next cycle

proposals.title: Monte Carlo Dropout uncertainty quantification
proposals.expected_gain: -0.005 to -0.010 Brier with GPU; marginal on CPU
proposals.evidence: MDPI 2026-01 paper achieves 0.20 Brier using RNN + MC Dropout. Adds epistemic uncertainty estimate.
proposals.constraint: CPU-only islands cannot run RNN efficiently. Applicable to GPU burst (Modal A10G, ZeroGPU H200).
proposals.implementation: In gpu-burst scripts, use LightGBM with dropout trees (num_drop=1, skip_drop=0.5) or tabular neural net (TabNet) with MC sampling.
proposals.action: HAWKEYE: research LightGBM dropout variants applicable to CPU islands

proposals.title: Extra Trees with full MAX_FEATURES=200 budget (proven S15 technique)
proposals.evidence: S15 top_performer gen 1306: extra_trees 200 features = fleet best 0.22062. Beats random_forest (S14 0.22431) and venn_abers (S22 0.22475 current).
proposals.recommendation: Ensure all islands allow extra_trees with 200 features in mutation space. S13 (extra_trees 61f = 0.2209) vs S15 (extra_trees 200f = 0.22062) confirms more features helps for ExtraTreesClassifier.
proposals.action: In GA mutate(): do not penalize high feature counts for extra_trees model type

proposals.title: Model stacking: extra_trees + xgboost_brier + lightgbm
proposals.evidence: Kaggle March Mania 2026 top solutions use gradient boosted ensembles. Literature consistently shows stacking beats single models by ~0.005 Brier.
proposals.constraint: CLAUDE.md Rule 8: CPU-only islands, stacking removed. This is for GPU burst only.
proposals.implementation: Modal A10G burst: train stacking ensemble (L1: extra_trees + xgboost + lgbm, L2: logistic meta-learner). Use island best configs as L1 base.

proposals.title: Strict 4-season chronological train/val/test split
proposals.evidence: MDPI 2026-01 paper specifically uses train≤2022/val=2023/test=2024. Our current GA uses random cross-validation. True OOS Brier may differ.
proposals.implementation: Verify island eval uses time-sorted split (latest 2 seasons = test). In features/engine.py, confirm sim_cutoff gating is active.
proposals.action: INTERNAL AFFAIRS: audit one island to confirm no future-data leakage in current evaluation

proposals.title: Game sequence features: last-N game embedding
proposals.evidence: RNN models in literature capture game momentum sequences. Engine v3.2 Cat22 CROSS_WINDOW_MOMENTUM (630 features) partially covers this but uses rolling statistics, not learned representations.
proposals.constraint: CPU-only islands cannot run RNN. GPU burst only.
proposals.implementation: Treat last-5 games as a sequence. Embed with simple GRU (hidden=32). Concatenate embedding with tabular features for final prediction.
proposals.action: Long-term HAWKEYE research target. Not for current sprint.
